column1: # .jargon-terms.tsv -- phrases Rob has said he could not follow, and the plain words that
# must appear in the same paragraph when one is used.
# The check fails when the phrase appears in a paragraph containing NONE of its plain words.
# A row with no plain words is ignored rather than honoured, so a half-written entry cannot
# silently disable the check for that phrase.
# HOW ENTRIES GET ADDED, AND IT IS THE ONLY WAY: Rob says he cannot follow something. Not a
# guess about what might confuse a reader -- a recorded instance. All four seed entries are
# 1. "Rule the key form for scripts" -- he asked what it meant.
# 2. "rule them exempt ... a permanently red suite" -- he asked what it meant.
# 3. "its cost profile rather than its verdict carries the proof" -- "I have no idea what
# 4. "the cheapest path through the script" -- same paragraph as 3.
